resources.string: Your iPhone runs CarPlay. This Android phone connects it to your Tesla or another compatible browser.
Turn on the hotspot in this Android phone’s settings. Use 5 GHz if available, and keep mobile data on to give your Tesla internet access.
Copy the network name and password exactly from this Android phone’s hotspot settings. Saving them here does not turn on or rename the hotspot.
Save your hotspot details to continue.
Your existing connection mode is preserved. You can keep it, or save this phone’s hotspot details to use its hotspot instead.
On your iPhone, turn on Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Join the network shown below. Pair the iPhone with this Android phone in Bluetooth settings, then choose it here.
Choose your paired iPhone to continue.
On your iPhone, open Settings → Bluetooth and pair with this Android phone. Keep Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on.
For Tesla, pair your iPhone directly with the car’s Bluetooth and select Bluetooth as the car’s audio source. Music and calls then use the car’s speakers and microphone.
For another screen, use your iPhone’s chosen audio output. This app does not play or record sound on the Android phone.
Connect your Tesla or other display device to the same network as your iPhone. In Tesla Wi-Fi settings, enable “Remain connected in Drive” if available.
Next, we will prepare the browser address and guide you through Android’s background and local-connection permissions. Type the complete HTTPS address shown on the dashboard into your browser.
Accept “Use CarPlay” on your iPhone when asked. Keep this Android phone powered; its screen can turn off once connected.
Your settings stay saved. Use the connection guide whenever you need to connect a new screen.
Open hotspot settings on this Android phone and turn on the network saved in TesAir. Then return here.
Reconnect to your saved iPhone when you open TesAir. While the app is running, temporary connection failures are retried automatically.
Android may ask for nearby-device, notification or location access while connecting. Grant only the permissions requested for your chosen connection.
The connection dashboard will show the network when it is available.
Open this phone’s hotspot QR code. Share it to TesAir, or save a screenshot and import it here. If no QR code is available, enter the details below.
Reading the QR image on this phone…
Review this phone’s hotspot details, then save. Importing does not turn on or change the hotspot.
Choose a clear hotspot QR image up to 16 MB, or enter the details manually.
No Wi-Fi QR code was found. Choose an image that shows the entire hotspot QR code.
This QR code does not contain supported hotspot details. Use a personal WPA2 or WPA3 network, or enter the details manually.
